ethioFresh_geography_module.title: The Shape of Ethiopia and its Implication (የኢትዮጵያ ቅርፅ እና አንድምታው)
ethioFresh_geography_module.overview: Countries of the World have different kinds of shape that can be divided into five main categories. These shapes have implications on defense, administration and economic integration.
ethioFresh_geography_module.exam_hint: 💡 ፈተና ላይ፡ የቅርፅ አይነቶችን ከነ ምሳሌያቸው (ለምሳሌ: South Africa = Perforated, Chile = Elongated) እንዲሁም የ Compactness መለኪያዎችን (ለምሳሌ፡ B/C Ratio ወደ 1 ሲጠጋ ምን ማለት እንደሆነ) በደንብ ይጠይቃሉ።

shape_categories.description: The distance from the geographic centre to any of the borders does not vary greatly. It is easier for defence, socioeconomic and cultural integration.
Divided from their other parts by either water, land or other countries.
Geographically long and relatively narrow like Chile.

shape_categories.type: Perforated shape (የተበሳሳ/በውስጡ ሌላ ሀገር የያዘ ቅርፅ)
shape_categories.description: A country that completely surrounds another country like the Republic of South Africa.
Countries that have one portion that is much more elongated than the rest of the country like Myanmar and Eritrea.

compactness_indices.details: The ratio of area of country to its boundary length. The higher the ratio, the greater the degree of compactness.
The ratio of boundary length to the circumference of a circle having the same area. The nearer the ratio to 1, the more compact the country is.
The ratio of the area to the circumference of the smallest inscribing circle. The higher the ratio, the greater the degree of compactness.
The ratio of the actual area to the smallest possible inscribing circle. The nearer the ratio to 1, the more compact the country is.

ethioFresh_geography_module.title: Basic Skills of Map Reading (የካርታ ንባብ መሰረታዊ ክህሎቶች)
ethioFresh_geography_module.definition: A map is a two-dimensional scaled representation of part or whole of the Earth surface on a flat body. Map reading encompasses a systematic identification of natural (mountains, plateaus, valleys, rivers) and manmade features (roads, railways, buildings, dams).
ethioFresh_geography_module.exam_hint: 💡 ፈተና ላይ፡ Map Reading ምን ምን ነገሮችን (Natural vs Manmade features) መለየት እንደሆነ እና የካርታን አጠቃላይ ጠቀሜታዎች (Importance of map) በ True/False ወይም Multiple Choice ይጠይቃሉ።
importance: Provide the basis for making geographical details of regions represented (relief, drainage, settlement).
Powerful tools for making spatial analysis of geographical facts.
Useful for giving location of geographical features using grid reference and place naming.
Used across various disciplines like land use planning, military science, aviation, tourism, epidemiology, etc.
Makes storage of the geographical data of areas represented.
Potentially used to assess reliable measurements of geographical features.

ethioFresh_geography_module.title: Types of Map and Marginal Information (የካርታ አይነቶች እና መግለጫ መረጃዎች)
ethioFresh_geography_module.exam_hint: 💡 ፈተና ላይ፡ Topographical እና Statistical map ልዩነታቸውን፤ እንዲሁም Marginal information (Scale, Key, North Arrow) ምንነትንና ጥቅምን በደንብ ያዙ።

map_types.details: Depict one or more natural and cultural features. Can be small, medium or large scale. Contents depend on purpose, scale, date of compilation, and nature of the land.
Show distribution of different aspects such as temperature, rainfall, settlement, vegetation.

marginal_information.purpose: Heading of the map which tells what the map is all about.
List of all conventional symbols and signs shown on the map with their interpretation.
Ratio between the map distance and actual ground distance (representative fraction, statement/verbal, linear/graphic).
Indicated with the north direction; used to know other important directions (east, west, south).
The frame of the map showing the end of the mapped area.
Date of publication enabling users to realize whether the map is updated or outdated.

ethioFresh_geography_module.title: Basic Principles of Map Reading (የካርታ ንባብ መሰረታዊ መርሆዎች)
ethioFresh_geography_module.exam_hint: 💡 ፈተና ላይ፡ Grid Reference System እንዴት ቦታን በትክክል ለማግኘት (Pinpoint location) እንደሚረዳ መገንዘብ ወሳኝ ነው።

principles.details: Readers must translate map symbols into landscape images. The first symbols introduced should refer to familiar landscape features.
Essential to orient and locate places. The north arrow should be determined first before locating features in relation to one another.
Maps are covered in a series of lines that make up a grid with numbers. These numbers provide a grid reference to accurately pinpoint a location.

ethioFresh_geography_module.end_note: ቻፕተር_1 ጨርሰናል በቀጣይ ቻፕተር_2 እንጀምራለን መልካም የጥናት ጊዜ ተመኘሁላችሁ😎።
